notes.title: Tidying Things Up!
notes.content:
Several updates have been made to the scene, addressing some of the bugs that were kindly reported by players.
Improvements have also been applied to the gallery to ensure a smoother and more polished experience overall.
Thank you, as always, for your feedback and support – it helps us keep everything in top shape!

notes.title: Ultrawide Support & Language Fix
notes.content:
We've just released a small but important update!

[b]Ultrawide Support[/b]
The game now supports ultrawide resolutions properly. Enjoy a more immersive experience with better screen scaling and improved UI layout for wider monitors!

[b]Language Fixes[/b]
We’ve corrected several translation issues and improved overall text issues. If you spotted anything odd in your language, it should now look much better!

Thanks for your support and feedback — it helps us make the game better for everyone. More updates are on the way!

notes.title: Language System Improvements
notes.content:
This update includes improvements to the language system to prevent issues with missing or broken characters. Text should now display correctly across all supported languages.

Special thanks to Ice for reporting the issue and for all the help with the game — your support has been incredibly valuable!

As always, let us know if you notice anything else that needs attention. Your feedback helps us keep making the game better!

notes.title: Fullscreen & Resolution Bug Fix
notes.content:
We’ve just released a patch that fixes issues related to fullscreen mode and screen resolution settings. The game should now launch and switch display modes more reliably, with proper support for various screen sizes.

Thanks to everyone who reported these problems — your input is super helpful! If anything still seems off, don’t hesitate to reach out.

notes.title: Update: Correct Bara Cards Uploaded!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just uploaded the correct version of the bara cards! 
Our apologies — the previous files were mistakenly the unedited versions and were not meant to be included in the game.

Everything should be working fine now, but if you run into any issues, feel free to let us know!

notes.title: Update - Audio Fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In this update, we’ve fixed an issue with the Mute button and the volume sliders in the game’s options. Audio controls should now work properly for a better experience!

A huge thanks to Winter for reporting this bug! 

Keep sending us your feedback—it’s essential for making the game even better.

notes.title: Where’s My Hentai Deck & Where’s My Bara Deck – Now Available!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Where’s My Hentai Deck and Where’s My Bara Deck are officially released!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45453949/2a6e474e1ff13c2509674e02bcbf90faa7fc01d9.jpg[/img]
[h1]Where’s My Hentai Deck[/h1]
A straight-themed hidden object game where you search for your lost hentai deck scattered around the house.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3515540/Wheres_my_Hentai_Deck

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45453949/29c4495e7dd6fc42ae5e43a2edebf110868164bf.jpg[/img]
[h1]Where’s My Bara Deck[/h1]
A bara-themed version where you must find your bara deck, hidden in various spots.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520290/Wheres_my_Bara_Deck

Both games offer a fun and spicy hidden object experience!

We also want to sincerely apologize for forgetting to apply the initial launch discount for Where’s My Bara Deck. This was an oversight on our part, and we appreciate your understanding.

Thank you for your support! We hope you enjoy the games!
